title: openapicontract/go.go
description: GenerateGo and generateGo render the OpenAPI models and clients for the Go SDK and the HTTP application, with nullable types on, so a nullable property keeps its three states (ST-SUP-RC06-OC08).

title: openapicontract/enums.go
description: stringEnumProperty gives the string enum types that the HTTP application's response mapping turns into a closed switch that refuses other values (ST-SUP-RC10-OC25).

title: openapicontract/models.go
description: GenerateGoModels binds the response model fields of the HTTP application to the selected OpenAPI schemas: required, nullable, omitted, string list and free object. No output contract states this yet.

title: openapicontract/input.go
description: Load and InputFiles read and bound the OpenAPI input of the Go SDK, the HTTP application and the TypeScript SDK: size, YAML aliases and duplicate keys, references, schema graph and names. It checks input at generation time and emits no code; no output contract states this.

title: responsemapping/inputs.go
description: PreparedInputs gives a response mapping of the gRPC or HTTP application its 1 to 128 named inputs with fixed Go types and kept presence (ST-SUP-RC07-OC15).

title: responsemapping/json_strings.go
description: JSONStringsSource emits jsonStrings, which returns an owned list or ErrConversion with no partial list and does no input or output (ST-SUP-RC10-OC25, ST-SUP-RC07-OC12).

title: responsemapping/json_objects.go
description: Emits jsonObject for the HTTP application: a bounded, strict JSON object that returns ErrConversion on refused input and an owned map (ST-SUP-RC10-OC25, ST-SUP-RC10-OC26).

title: browserapplication/config.go
description: Reads the local_applications declaration for the browser backend, the health check and the Kubernetes service, and refuses a local application secret that is the same as a browser backend secret (ST-SUP-RC15-OC33).

title: browserassets/html.go
description: ScriptHashes computes the SHA-256 hashes of the inline scripts of the captured index.html, and refuses event and style attributes, style elements and external scripts that are not captured, so the page policy lists exact hashes (ST-SUP-RC02-OC16, ST-SUP-RC02-OC17).

title: buildidentity/render.go
description: Source gives the build identity source that the CLI application emits, so the version command reports a stable build record (ST-SUP-RC04-OC29).

title: gen/json_validation.go
description: UnicodeEscapeValidation emits validUnicodeEscapes, which the emitted JSON readers call to refuse an unpaired surrogate escape (ST-SUP-RC10-OC11, ST-SUP-RC10-OC21, ST-SUP-RC11-OC24, ST-SUP-RC11-OC27, ST-SUP-RC13-OC21, ST-SUP-RC02-OC35).

title: gen/database_access.go
description: DatabaseObject declares the database objects and privileges a component's code needs, which the assembled access check holds the runtime login to (ST-SUP-RC02-OC29); BackupObject declares what a backup must include, which no output contract states yet.

title: compiler/http_diagnostics.go
description: The assembler emits the HTTP server's diagnostic log: a fixed message, a bounded queue that drops when full, and a close that waits at most one second (ST-SUP-RC10-OC30).

title: compiler/http_lifecycle.go
description: The assembler emits stegoServeHTTP: one server with the request limits and the shutdown drain, for a TLS listener as for a plaintext one (ST-SUP-RC10-OC29).

title: compiler/http_tls.go
description: The assembler emits the TLS 1.3 transport, which reads the certificate and key once from private, bounded, absolute local files, or stops startup (ST-SUP-RC10-OC28).

title: compiler/database_access.go
description: generateDatabaseAccess emits the startup access check and the backup manifest: the runtime login MUST hold only the declared privileges, not as owner (ST-SUP-RC02-OC29).

title: compiler/database_config.go
description: The assembler emits the reader of DATABASE_URL or DATABASE_URL_FILE: exactly one, bounded, from a private file. No output contract states this yet.

title: slot/operators.go
description: GenerateOperators emits the gate, chain and fan-out operators that compose the fills of a slot. No output contract states their order and stop rules yet.

title: slot/generate.go
description: GenerateInterface emits each slot's Go interface from its proto: one method for each RPC. No output contract states this yet.

title: browserassets/bundle.go
description: The format of a browser asset bundle: a deterministic ZIP with sorted entries and fixed metadata, its file names and its size limits. Encode and Decode check every entry. The compiler captures a bundle in this format (ST-GEN-CMD04-H), and the browser backend generator reads it to emit the captured page and its assets.
